maintenance_led.reason: Fee-based wealth management, equity management and OCIO services for families, institutions and endowments; not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are wealthy individuals and families, institutions, endowments and foundations paying advisory fees; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic through client advisory and asset management relationships; the website shows no steady acquisition program.

mission_critical.reason: Outsourced CIO and family office services embed deeply in client portfolios, tax and estate planning; switching means disruptive transitions.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; switching wealth managers is sticky but not regulation-mandated.
